Senior Backend Engineer
Acme Payments — Bengaluru (Hybrid)

About us
Acme Payments builds payment infrastructure for over 20,000 merchants across India.

What you'll do
• Design, build and operate scalable microservices in Python and Go that process millions of transactions per day
• Own RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations using Kafka
• Improve reliability and observability of payment systems with Prometheus and Grafana
• Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional teams to ship features end-to-end
• Mentor junior engineers and lead code reviews
• Optimize PostgreSQL queries and data models for high-throughput workloads

Requirements
• 5+ years of experience in backend development
• Strong proficiency in Python (Django or FastAPI)
• Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis and message queues such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
• Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker and Kubernetes
• Solid understanding of distributed systems, system design and payment systems
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Nice to have
• Experience with Go or Rust
• Familiarity with PCI DSS compliance
• Exposure to Terraform and infrastructure as code

Benefits
• Competitive salary, health insurance, flexible work hours
